automatic_skills.name: caveman:investigate-first
automatic_skills.trigger: Diagnose an ambiguous failure, intermittent behavior, or performance regression before editing.

automatic_skills.name: caveman:surgical-patch
automatic_skills.trigger: Implement a requested scoped bug fix or small behavior change.

automatic_skills.name: caveman:safe-refactor
automatic_skills.trigger: Perform a requested extraction, consolidation, or structural cleanup while preserving behavior.

automatic_skills.name: caveman:verify-and-stop
automatic_skills.trigger: Run requested validation or final acceptance checks and stop when the proof is complete.

automatic_skills.name: writing-for-agents
automatic_skills.trigger: Create or edit a skill, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md; reviewing the skill catalog alone does not activate it.

automatic_skills.name: pr
automatic_skills.trigger: Provide summary, evidence, and impact guidance only while drafting/revising the body of a specific PR; exclude review-only, coding-only, PR research, and template/skill editing.

automatic_skills.name: write-pr-description
automatic_skills.trigger: Draft/revise a specific PR title or body when requested or while executing authorized PR creation/update; exclude review-only, coding-only, PR research, and template/skill editing.
